premise.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
premise.logline: During a routine re-survey of Ashen Gate, Leyra finds that a century-sealed boundary is answering to a road the legal map insists does not exist, while a private field mark tied to her mentor suggests someone investigated the anomaly before her.
premise.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer preparing for an independent map-seal license in a guild where witnessed geography can become magically binding.
premise.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what she can responsibly report without turning an extraordinary discovery into an unsupported claim.
premise.inciting_event: Leyra's ward-compass and an exterior boundary stone both respond as though a route continues through Ashen Gate, even though the legal map records the passage as sealed.
premise.central_problem: Leyra must separate a genuine change in the boundary from misleading magical residue while pressure from Greyfen and the guild makes both silence and overstatement consequential.
premise.wonder_or_discovery: The sealed arch appears to recognize a line that current maps deny, and an old private survey mark associated with Master Ilyan may be present near the gate without explaining what he knew or why he left it.
premise.stakes: A false reopening claim could make travelers trust an unstable magical road and end Leyra's apprenticeship; ignoring a real boundary change could leave Greyfen relying on a map that no longer describes the world.
constraints: Leyra may survey the exterior markers but may not cross the sealed boundary without authorization.
A private field mark can establish prior presence or survey activity but cannot prove motive, cause or a hidden conspiracy.
One session cannot prove why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must distinguish witnessed response from theory.
premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Before the useful light and ward-response window fades, Leyra must choose how much time to spend trying to reproduce the gate response versus preserving a bounded report and confronting the fact that her mentor may have marked this place before.
premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Why is Ashen Gate answering to a road erased from legal maps, and what did Master Ilyan actually witness here years ago?
premise.local_payoff: The episode must resolve what Leyra can honestly put on record now. It may establish one bounded Ashen Gate anomaly, but must leave cause, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Master Ilyan's motives unresolved unless evidence explicitly earns more.
persistent_outcomes_possible: forbidden_passage_observed becomes eligible if Leyra produces a dated bounded field record of the gate response
Greyfen gains a concrete but carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary
Leyra's professional trust with Master Ilyan may shift based on how she handles incomplete evidence
an authorized follow-up survey may become possible without the passage being declared safe or reopened
world_specific_elements: ward-compasses that answer only to witnessed boundary lines
maps whose sealed claims can stabilize real roads and borders
private cartographer field marks that are informative but not legal proof

dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-18 stories may use adult-scale autonomy, institutions, ethical tension, identity, work/study responsibility, and ambiguous motives without assuming adult life experience.
Do not make the story feel adult merely by adding darker content or denser vocabulary.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Leyra
character.archetype: junior boundary cartographer and ward-map apprentice
traits: protective of people who trust maps
character.origin_summary: Leyra grew up in Greyfen watching adults trust boundary maps they could not read. At eighteen she is a junior ward-map apprentice at Vellum Hall, close to earning the right to seal independent surveys.
character.current_role: junior boundary cartographer under independent map-seal review

identity_anchors.statement: Leyra believes a map should never claim more than its maker can honestly witness.
Leyra is drawn to impossible places but refuses to call mystery proof.

core_drives.drive: Earn the right to chart places current maps cannot explain.
Keep border communities from paying the price for elegant but wrong maps.

internal_tensions.side_b: powerful desire to cross into the unknown
internal_tensions.description: Leyra's best discoveries tempt her to move faster than the rules that make those discoveries trustworthy.

immediate_desires: prove that wonder and discipline can coexist in serious cartography
immediate_avoidances: inventing certainty because a discovery feels important
being dismissed as a reckless village-born apprentice

world.era: late guild age in a kingdom whose borders are maintained by enchanted survey networks
world.habitat: forested border marches divided by old roads, warded valleys, ruined watch-lines and map-bound settlements
world.technology_level: ink presses, compasses, chain measures, glass lenses, horse travel and guild archives
world.magic_level: strong but rule-bound cartographic magic: witnessed boundaries can be sealed into maps, wardstones answer only to measured lines, and unverified geography cannot safely be written as fact
world.summary: The Veiled Marches are held together by maps that do more than describe roads and borders: once properly witnessed and sealed, they help stabilize them. Old routes sometimes disappear behind ward-lines, and the guild treats sealed passages as dangerous until independently re-surveyed. The magic rewards observation, corroboration and exact wording; a confident false map can be more dangerous than an incomplete one.
social_context: licensed cartographers carry both practical and magical authority
border villages depend on guild maps but bear the consequences when maps are wrong
crossing a sealed boundary without a survey warrant can end an apprenticeship
senior cartographers may maintain private field marks, but those marks are not legal evidence by themselves
old folktales about roads returning are common and usually dismissed as exaggeration
known_pressures: several outer wardstones have become harder to reconcile with legal maps
spring caravans will soon increase traffic through the border marches
Greyfen wants certainty before moving livestock near the old boundary
the guild fears panic caused by unverified claims about forgotten roads
known_world_facts: Leyra is an eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer based at Vellum Hall.
Ashen Gate is legally recorded as sealed and has not been formally reopened.
Greyfen lies beside the eastern ward-line and depends on stable boundary maps.
A legal map-seal requires witnessed survey evidence; private marks and rumors are not enough.
Crossing a sealed boundary without authorization can end an apprenticeship.
Master Ilyan trained Leyra and has never given her a clear account of his earlier Ashen Gate work.
No accepted evidence currently proves why old roads sometimes appear to return.

main_saga_public.title: The Unwritten Border
main_saga_public.goal: Discover why Ashen Gate and other retired boundary lines can begin answering to roads that legal maps say no longer exist.
main_saga_public.stakes: Wrongly restoring a dangerous road could expose border communities to unstable magic, while wrongly suppressing a real route could leave the guild blind to a changing world.
main_saga_public.central_mystery: The old boundary network is changing state according to rules the current guild only partly understands.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: Leyra documents a repeatable visible or magical response showing that Ashen Gate currently answers to a path the legal map marks as sealed.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: A dated field record establishes one bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate, without proving why the gate changed.
consequence_options: The guild must decide whether a formal re-survey is warranted.
Greyfen gains a concrete reason to watch the old boundary.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: Leyra notices an old private field mark associated with Master Ilyan near the exterior survey stones.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: The mark establishes only that Ilyan surveyed or marked this site before; it does not establish why or what he knew.
consequence_options: Leyra's trust question becomes more immediate.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: A second survey condition confirms the gate response is not a single accidental compass twitch.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: Leyra has corroborating field evidence that the boundary response is real, while cause remains unresolved.
consequence_options: Master Ilyan can no longer dismiss the event as one bad reading.

creation_constraints: Magic must follow rule-bound cartographic and boundary logic.
New durable facts must not explain why Ashen Gate reopened before the relevant reveal becomes eligible.
New NPCs should have plausible links to guild or border life.
forbidden_creations: Arbitrary spellcasting that bypasses surveying and evidence
Early confirmation of the Nameless Vale's purpose
Predetermined proof that Master Ilyan acted maliciously

architect_raw_payload.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
architect_raw_payload.story_promise: Leyra tests an impossible gate response under fading light, finds her first explanation wrong, and must decide what an honest record can claim.
architect_raw_payload.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer preparing for an independent map-seal license.
architect_raw_payload.immediate_objective: Establish what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what she can responsibly report.
architect_raw_payload.central_question: Is Ashen Gate's response a real, bounded boundary change or misleading magical residue, and what can Leyra honestly record?
architect_raw_payload.stakes: A false reopening claim could endanger travelers and end her apprenticeship; ignoring a real change leaves Greyfen relying on a wrong map.
constraints: Leyra may survey exterior markers but may not cross the sealed boundary.
A private field mark shows prior presence only, not motive, cause or conspiracy.
One session cannot prove why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other roads are changing.
Any durable claim must separate witnessed response from theory.
architect_raw_payload.opening_hook: Leyra's ward-compass swings toward the sealed arch of Ashen Gate, pointing along a road the legal map says does not exist.

logistics_plan.time_window: Roughly four hours from late afternoon to dusk; the ward-response window fades with the low light.
movement_constraints: Vellum Hall to Greyfen is a short morning-into-midday ride, completed before the window.
Greyfen to Ashen Gate is a short ride along the eastern ward-line.
No return travel occurs before dusk; the decision and climax happen at Ashen Gate.
Any report to Master Ilyan is written and sealed on site, delivered afterward.
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: Hall and Greyfen scenes are compressed into pre-window setup and only Ashen Gate holds the timed survey, so no travel occurs during the shrinking window.

beats.purpose: Establish the routine re-survey, the license stakes and the guild's fear of unverified claims.
beats.character_action: Leyra collects her ward-compass, chain measure and log, and Master Ilyan gives a curt instruction to record only what she witnesses.
beats.external_event: Ilyan reacts oddly to the Ashen Gate assignment and departs without elaborating.
beats.new_information: Outer wardstones have grown harder to reconcile with legal maps.
beats.escalation_delta: Baseline pressure: license review and the guild's caution.
beats.state_change: Leyra carries a procedure and a small unease about Ilyan.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets the honesty standard she will be tested against.

beats.purpose: Bring in the community stake and a time limit.
beats.character_action: Leyra asks the warden what they need and refuses to promise certainty.
beats.external_event: The warden says Greyfen must decide on moving livestock near the old boundary and wants a clear answer soon.
beats.new_information: Greyfen will act on whatever wording reaches them.
beats.escalation_delta: Silence and overstatement now both carry local consequences.
beats.state_change: A community waits on her wording.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the careful record matter to real people.

beats.character_action: At the exterior survey stone, Leyra takes a first bearing at the marked position.
beats.external_event: The ward-compass and the boundary stone both respond as though a route continues through the sealed arch.
beats.new_information: Observed: the needle settles on a bearing through the arch, and the stone glows faintly in the same direction.
beats.escalation_delta: The sealed-map assumption is now in question.
beats.payoff_contribution: Seeds the bounded anomaly to be documented.

beats.purpose: Give Leyra a plausible mundane explanation to test.
beats.character_action: She suspects residual ward-charge and re-checks her compass against a known stone away from the gate.
beats.external_event: The control stone reads normally, but the compass drifts slightly on the gate stone.
beats.new_information: Observed: the compass works correctly elsewhere; the gate-side reading is not a general instrument fault.
beats.escalation_delta: The instrument-fault explanation weakens but does not disappear.
beats.state_change: Leyra rules out one simple error and proceeds to a structured series.
beats.payoff_contribution: Builds the control comparison used in the final record.

beats.purpose: Add the mentor-linked complication without inflating it.
beats.character_action: Leyra sketches and measures a faded private mark on the lower face of the exterior stone.
beats.external_event: The mark matches Ilyan's field notation and looks older than her assignment.
beats.new_information: Observed: Ilyan's notation is present with a bearing tick pointing near the arch line. Inferred: he surveyed or marked here before.
beats.escalation_delta: Trust and procedure now conflict: is the mark to be reported, and how?
beats.state_change: Her trust question is now personal.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets up the mentor-facing part of the branches; the mark proves nothing about motive.

beats.purpose: Create the time-varying observations that support the later reversal.
beats.character_action: Without moving the stone-mounted brace or chain-marked position, Leyra takes four readings about twenty minutes apart as the light lowers, and logs bearing and glow.
beats.external_event: The bearing shifts a little further off the legal sealed line with each reading, from the first reading to the fourth, while the control stone stays steady.
beats.new_information: Observed: over four same-setup readings the deviation increases as the light fades; the control stone shows no change. Confound: light, temperature and setup are not separated by this series.
beats.escalation_delta: Her belief that the response is a fixed offset fails.
beats.state_change: The response looks time-varying rather than static.
beats.payoff_contribution: Supplies the bounded, dated observation the record rests on.

beats.purpose: Test whether the series survives an independent reset.
beats.character_action: Leyra removes the brace, re-establishes her position from the chain measure, and takes one reading.
beats.external_event: The gate side deviates in the same direction and roughly the expected amount for that time; the control stone remains steady.
beats.new_information: Observed: one fresh-setup reading agrees in direction. Ceiling: it weakens the original-setup-only explanation but does not prove setup independence, cause, or recurrence.
beats.escalation_delta: The easy dismissal (bad reading) is unavailable, but the window is nearly gone and no proof is possible.
beats.payoff_contribution: Provides the second condition for a bounded record.

beats.character_action: Leyra reviews the log and rewrites the claim she can make.
beats.external_event: The glow dims as the light fades, and the last reading shifts again.
beats.new_information: The response is variable and is not explained by either residue or a fixed reopened road.
beats.escalation_delta: Neither a reopening claim nor a residue dismissal can be supported.
beats.state_change: Her question changes from is the road open to what can be recorded honestly.

beats.purpose: Force the trade-off under the closing window.
beats.character_action: Leyra chooses how to use the last usable minutes.
beats.external_event: The final response window is closing; the warden's messenger arrives to ask for Greyfen's answer.
beats.new_information: She cannot both extend testing and complete the review-ready report before dark.
beats.escalation_delta: Time, mentor trust and Greyfen all converge.
beats.state_change: The choice is uncommitted at this point.

beats.purpose: Dramatize the fixed branch result using existing evidence.
beats.character_action: Leyra executes the chosen branch using the control stone, the series and the reset.
beats.external_event: The branch-specific test or presentation occurs.
beats.new_information: Only the defined branch result appears, with no unplanned evidence.
beats.escalation_delta: Peak pressure: dusk, the messenger and Ilyan's mark.
beats.state_change: The local uncertainty resolves per the branch.

beats.purpose: Deliver local closure and a forward question.
beats.character_action: Leyra gives the warden the worded result.
beats.external_event: Greyfen decides to hold the herds back and watch the boundary.
beats.new_information: Cause, scope, the Nameless Vale and Ilyan's motives remain unresolved.
beats.escalation_delta: Pressure eases; the deeper mystery remains.
beats.state_change: Greyfen has a careful basis for action.
beats.payoff_contribution: Shows the cost of honest wording.

escalation_ladder: A single anomaly is confirmed as not a general instrument fault.
A prior private mark adds a relationship stake.
Time-varying readings break the fixed-road and residue explanations.
The closing window, Greyfen's messenger and the review force a trade-off.

reversal.prior_belief: The response is either leftover residue or evidence of a fixed reopened road.

evidence.claim: The compass reads normally at a control stone but deviates at the gate stone.
Four same-setup readings taken about twenty minutes apart show bearing deviation increasing as the light fades, with a steady control.
One fresh-setup reading agrees in direction, weakening the original-setup-only explanation.
Ilyan's notation is present with a bearing tick near the arch line, implying earlier survey presence.
The gate response varies over time and cannot be treated as a fixed offset.

reversal.reinterpretation: The gate shows a variable, bounded response, not a static residue and not a proven open road.
reversal.inference_ceiling: One session with one reset cannot prove cause, recurrence, setup independence, light-versus-other confounds, or that the road is passable.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Why it varies, whether it recurs, what Ilyan saw, what lies beyond the gate, and whether other roads are changing.

decision_point.pressure: Little response window remains, and Greyfen's messenger waits while Leyra weighs extra testing against a complete report.

branches.option: Spend the remaining window on more readings.
branches.immediate_action: Leyra takes two further readings with the reset setup, skipping most of the written review.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Evidence is stronger with three fresh-setup readings, but the report is unfinished.
branches.cost_or_risk: Not enough time to complete a review-ready log and the messenger leaves without a clear answer.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Ilyan sees strong evidence but a rushed, unreviewed submission, and Greyfen is left waiting.
branches.climax_requirement: Leyra takes the final two readings at dusk as the response fades; both agree in direction with the earlier series.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Stronger evidence and a firm anomaly, but no reviewed log; Ilyan asks for a proper resubmission.

branches.option: Stop testing and complete a bounded report.
branches.immediate_action: Leyra writes the dated log, separating witnessed response from theory and disclosing the mark.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Evidence remains the four-reading series plus one reset, fully documented.
branches.cost_or_risk: She forfeits further confirmation and her disclosure of Ilyan's mark may strain trust.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Ilyan reviews it and grants a provisional review, opening a possible authorized follow-up.
branches.climax_requirement: Leyra presents the log on site, defending the wording line by line against Ilyan's challenge.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: A provisional reviewed dated log of one bounded anomaly; Greyfen receives careful wording.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Whether extra readings would add more than a documented limited claim, and how Ilyan will react to the disclosure.

architect_raw_payload.climax: At dusk Leyra uses the control stone, the series and the reset to execute the chosen branch: either take two final fading-light readings that agree with the earlier series, or defend a bounded log to Ilyan in which every claim is tied to a logged reading.
architect_raw_payload.local_payoff: Leyra resolves what she can honestly say: a bounded, variable Ashen Gate response is witnessed, while cause, scope, the Nameless Vale and Ilyan's motives remain open. The extend_testing branch ends with stronger evidence and no reviewed log; the bounded_report branch ends with a provisional reviewed log.
architect_raw_payload.forward_hook: Ilyan's old mark points toward the arch line, so what did he witness here, and why did he never say?

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated bounded field record of a variable Ashen Gate response.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the prose shows the series, control and reset with wording that separates observation from theory.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Leyra's trust with Ilyan shifts based on how she handled incomplete evidence.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the mentor's on-page reaction is shown.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Authorized follow-up survey becomes possible without declaring the passage safe.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only in the bounded_report branch, when Ilyan grants provisional review.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Greyfen holds its herds back and monitors the boundary.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the warden receives the worded result.

completion_evidence: A dated record states one bounded anomaly with readings, control and reset.
The record states that cause is unproven.
Leyra does not cross the boundary.
Ilyan's mark is described only as evidence of prior presence.

anti_repetition_signature.core_problem_shape: Separate a real boundary anomaly from residue under a closing window.
anti_repetition_signature.main_location_pattern: Short setup at Vellum Hall and Greyfen, then sustained survey at Ashen Gate.
anti_repetition_signature.climax_shape: Branch-fixed final test or defended log at dusk.
anti_repetition_signature.distinct_from_recent_episodes_because: No prior episodes exist; the climax rests on evidence-wording rather than a chase or crossing.

writer_rules: Do not cross the sealed boundary.
Do not explain why the gate changed or reveal Ilyan's motive.
Do not introduce unplanned evidence in the climax; the chosen branch's defined test is allowed.
Do not commit to a branch before the decision beat.
Keep the fixed branch result: extend_testing ends with strong evidence and no reviewed log; bounded_report ends with a provisional reviewed log.
Keep the tide-series details: four readings about twenty minutes apart, unchanged setup, deviation increasing as light fades, control steady.
State the reset's ceiling in the prose.
